title: PRISM: A Category-Theoretic Framework for Measuring and Refining Multimodal Analogies
abstract: arXiv:2610.01383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analogical reasoning involves identifying and preserving relational structures across domains. However, existing approaches to AI-driven multimodal analogy generation lack an interpretable measure of whether this structure is understood and maintained in the generated output. We address this gap with Pullback Refinement via Interpretable Structural Mapping (PRISM), a modality-agnostic framework for measuring and improving relational alignment in multimodal analogies, evaluated on visual metaphor generation. PRISM represents analogies as explicit relational mappings grounded in category theory and uses VLMs to instantiate these structures across modalities. Its first component, the pullback score, quantifies relational alignment from the resulting graph representation. On the AnaloBench benchmark, selecting the correct analogy purely by pullback score achieves 82.5% accuracy, demonstrating that the score captures meaningful relational inf

translated_title: PRISM：一个用于度量与精炼多模态类比的范畴论框架
translated_abstract: 类比推理涉及跨领域识别并保持关系结构。然而，现有的AI驱动多模态类比生成方法缺乏一种可解释的度量方式，无法判断这种结构在生成结果中是否被理解和保持。我们通过“基于可解释结构映射的拉回精炼”框架（PRISM）来弥补这一空白，这是一个与模态无关的框架，用于度量和改进多模态类比中的关系对齐，并在视觉隐喻生成任务上进行了评估。PRISM将类比为基于范畴论的显式关系映射，并利用视觉语言模型（VLM）跨模态实例化这些结构。其第一个组件——拉回分数，从生成的图表示中量化关系对齐程度。在AnaloBench基准测试中，仅凭拉回分数选择正确类比即可达到82.5%的准确率，证明该分数能够捕捉有意义的关系信息。
tldr: PRISM框架基于范畴论将多模态类比为显式关系映射，并引入“拉回分数”来量化关系对齐程度，在AnaloBench基准上仅凭该分数即可达到82.5%的选择准确率。
en_tdlr: PRISM is a category-theoretic, modality-agnostic framework that represents multimodal analogies as explicit relational mappings and introduces a pullback score to quantify relational alignment, achieving 82.5% accuracy on AnaloBench using the score alone for analogy selection.
